title: Future Crew - Second Reality (1993) [60fps]
summary: A 60fps capture of Future Crew's 1993 MS-DOS demo Second Reality, one of the best-known pieces of the demoscene. It runs about 16 minutes of real-time graphics and music effects on PC hardware of the era.
why: HN commenters cite it as the landmark demo of the demoscene's golden era, and this capture lets people watch it without running it under DOS.

quote.text: Future Crew's 2nd Reality demo, for those that haven't seen it
